# Cademí for developers

> Public issue tracker for the Cademí API v3, webhooks, Cademí MCP, and the cademi CLI. The cademi CLI is the command-line tool for the Cademí API v3 (an LMS): every API operation as a command, human or credential sign-in, event forwarding to localhost, declarative configuration, and file transfer. Install with `curl -fsSL https://cli.cademi.dev/install.sh | bash`; authenticate unattended with `CADEMI_API_KEY`; list the command domains with `cademi commands --groups --brief --json`, then the commands of one domain with `cademi commands <domain> --json`.
